description: URGENT help from a human while you are blocked on something only a human can do — log in once in the attached browser, confirm MFA, solve a captcha, re-authorise a connector. The person gets a Windows notification in DelegAIze Connect (and the request in the delegations inbox) and answers Erledigt / Abgelehnt (+ optional text). Their answer resumes THIS session automatically (no polling) — meanwhile continue with other work and retry the blocked step when the answer arrives. If nobody answers before the deadline, the answer is 'Frist abgelaufen — niemand hat geantwortet' — then end that part with exactly this reason. NEVER put a password, token or one-time code into any field (the request is rejected). Not for questions without time pressure — use delegate_to_user for those. Required: subject, reason, system, action_needed. Optional: urgency (hoch|normal, default hoch), expires_in_minutes (default 15, max 120), to_user_id (default: you/the key owner, else an admin).

expires_in_minutes.description: Minutes to wait for an answer before it expires; default 15, max 120

urgency.description: How urgent the request is; default hoch

wait.description: Gleich auf die Antwort warten (hoechstens 240 s pro Aufruf). Fuer Aufrufer ohne Runner-Sitzung der Weg, nach dem Klick des Menschen selbst weiterzumachen.

wait_seconds.description: Wartezeit dieses einen Aufrufs, Vorgabe 50, hoechstens 240.

name: request_urgent_help
